from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record extracted from a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as written in the document")
    legal_causes: list[Literal[
        '行政行为-行政撤销',
        '物权保护纠纷',
        '适用特殊程序案件案由',
        '侵犯财产罪',
        '侵权责任纠纷',
        '刑事赔偿',
        '行政主体-劳动和社会保障行政管理（劳动，社会保障）',
        '妨碍社会管理秩序罪'
    ]] = Field(description="The legal cause categories identified in this document from the predefined list of 8")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
